result:
A new plan's start date must now be today or later, and the date picker no longer offers past dates. I tested on copies, including a copy of your real data, and clicked through the rules in a real browser. All the test suites I ran pass, your real database's fingerprint stayed the same, and nothing is committed.

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| New plan, past date | Stays on the Goal step with an error |
| New plan, today or later | Allowed |
| Editing, keeping the saved start date even if it has passed | Allowed, and the rest of the edit saves normally |
| Editing, changing to a different past date | Stays on the Goal step with an error |
| Editing, changing to today or later | Allowed |

**Two behaviours you might notice**
- **The error's wording:** if you type a past date on a new plan, the browser catches it first and shows its own small message, "Value must be 10/31/2026 or later." The app's own message, "The training start date can't be in the past.", appears when the browser's check doesn't apply, such as on the edit case below. The server checks the date either way, so a past date can't get through, even if it's slipped in at the last step.
- **Editing a plan whose start date has passed:** the picker still offers dates from the saved start date up to yesterday. If its minimum were today, the browser would refuse to let you keep the saved date and you couldn't get past the Goal step. Picking one of those other past dates gets the app's error.

No existing plan's dates change, and I confirmed your copied plans can keep their current start dates when edited.

Only `app.py` and `templates/plan_form.html` changed. Restart the app to see this. The login and signup pages are unchanged.
